name: Santa's Baby Care & Nursery
storyline: In the heart of the North Pole, Santa has opened a special nursery to care for magical babies while preparing for Christmas. As his trusted assistant, you’re in charge of keeping the little ones happy and healthy. From feeding baby reindeer to dressing up tiny elves in festive outfits, your job is to make sure everything runs smoothly before Santa’s big night. But with snowstorms, mischievous giggles, and magical surprises, every day in the nursery is full of cheerful chaos.
summary: Santa's Baby Care & Nursery is a casual simulation game designed for young audiences, where players take on the role of Santa’s helper in a magical nursery. The goal is to care for baby elves and other festive characters by feeding, bathing, dressing, and entertaining them in a cozy North Pole setting. With colorful graphics and simple touch-based controls, the game offers a lighthearted holiday-themed experience focused on nurturing and creativity.
